issue.title: Recognize unsigiled extensionless relative directories in pager documents
issue.description: Proposed by phase sase-xy.5.4 while verifying pager target integrity. The Rust document scanner recognizes ./docs/assets and extension-bearing paths, but docs/assets is not emitted as a link; repository-owned suffix resolution likewise indexes files rather than directories. Add a bounded, syntax-only recognition rule with explicit false-positive coverage, and keep directory resolution repository-aware after sase-xy.5 completes its in-scope resolver repair.

task_type_fields.proposal: Recognize unsigiled extensionless relative directory paths such as docs/assets as actionable pager links, with repository-aware directory landing.
task_type_fields.why_out_of_scope: Epic sase-xy.5 promises correctness for links already rendered by the pager; bare extensionless relative directories were not part of that prior recognition surface. Supporting them is an additive capability and needs separate false-positive policy.
